name: lakky
description: Lakky — a stunning modern media player built on Electrobun + Bun.

scripts.build: vite build && electrobun build --env=stable && bun scripts/embed-icon.ts && bun scripts/build-installer.ts
scripts.build:canary: vite build && electrobun build --env=canary && bun scripts/embed-icon.ts && bun scripts/build-installer.ts
